summary: Build an AI portfolio, assess risk, and plan governance with practical exercises. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: AI strategy training for business leaders helps executives, business unit leaders, and digital transformation professionals select viable AI opportunities aligned with business goals. Participants practise assessing use cases and data readiness, prioritizing portfolios by value, feasibility, and risk, and assigning accountable oversight. The course also covers the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 concepts to shape governance, roadmaps, and performance measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape AI investment, governance, or business adoption and need to connect opportunities with operational capacity and accountable oversight.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of business planning, digital transformation, or technology-enabled operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI model development and production deployment are introduced at conceptual level; the course focuses on business strategy, governance, and investment decisions.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
